why: Declare Blockers phase: opponent's Rumbling Baloth (4/4) attacking. I have no creatures to block with (only Mountains). Pass to allow unblocked 4 damage to resolve (7 → 3 life). After combat damage, I'll have only 3 life remaining—one more Baloth attack kills me. My turn 15 draw is now do-or-die: must find burn spell or face imminent defeat. Opponent at 5 life, still vulnerable to any direct damage.
